vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A published CVE is a present risk; the cooldown exists to catch a hypothetical compromised release. Security updates therefore skip the age gate and the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Every open alert here is a transitive dependency in package-lock.json, which no direct-dependency bump reaches. Not automerged: this repo has no test or build check, so nothing would validate the refreshed lock file.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor and digests (gated by digest-cooldown for docker)
Docker digest age gate is unenforceable (renovate#38656); digest-cooldown workflow gates instead
